capabilities: strip bold markers outside code and math
remove non-breaking spaces from lines and inline text
fix colon spacing following Korean punctuation rules
re-wrap paragraphs and quotes at sentence boundaries
extras: Keeps code blocks, math, and YAML front matter untouched; warns to leave Prettier's proseWrap at its default when combining line-breaking with Prettier; shows notices explaining why nothing changed.
problem: Text pasted from chat assistants, web pages, or other editors arrives with stray bold markers, non-breaking spaces, one-sentence paragraphs, and wrong colon spacing that Obsidian's core commands do not fix.

relations.evidence: The last command calls the Prettier community plugin if it is installed and enabled.

summary: Command-based Markdown cleaner that strips bold markers, non-breaking spaces, and fixes paragraph and colon spacing in pasted text, tuned for Korean.
